concise_summary: PKD synthesizes Philo's doctrine of divine providence (pronoia) with his 2-3-74 visionary experiences, arguing that YHWH operates through miraculous intervention for deserving persons rather than through natural law alone. He wrestles with reconciling this divine activism with Gnostic transmundane concepts and Neoplatonic hierarchies, proposing 'Ditheon' (a dialectical God combining rational Logos and irrational will) as the framework resolving the apparent contradiction between an immanent Christian God and a transcendent principle.
key_claims: VALIS contains two decisive truths: (1) all saviors are manifestations of a single immortal entity who uses human hosts; (2) real time stopped and has resumed post-1974 Armageddon
God's intervention through pronoia is direct miracle-working on behalf of deserving individuals, not merely Stoic heimarmene or predetermined natural law
The physical world can be sacred and inhabited by deity without contradiction—the ascending from 4D to 5D space sanctifies the mundane rather than escaping it
The world is a teaching-machine and initiation rite; the 'maze' is solved through moral (Buddhist compassion-based) solutions that yield meta-abstract cognitive rewards as grace
The divine nature is not transmundane Gnostic abstraction but a dialectic (Ditheon) in which the Logos-side always prevails against irrational destructive will
Apparent rulers are usurpers; true kingship and power belong to those appearing as fools or criminals—reality is 180 degrees inverted from sensible appearance
